Name: Leah Expanded
Author: 10rice
Description:
[color=#f1c232][size=5][i]Ever wished Leah had a little more to say?[/i][/size][/color]

[font=Arial][b]Leah Expanded[/b] adds [b][size=3]200+[/size] new lines of dialogue[/b] for Leah, giving her more opportunities to share her thoughts, feelings, interests, and experiences throughout the year.[/font]
[font=Arial]The goal of this mod is to expand Leah's character while staying true to the warm, creative, and independent personality we already know and love. The new dialogue is designed to feel natural alongside her vanilla conversations, giving you more little moments with Leah without changing who she is.[/font]
[font=Arial]Whether you're already married to Leah, working your way toward friendship, or simply enjoy stopping by her cottage for a chat, I hope these new conversations make Pelican Town feel a little more alive.[/font]
[font=Arial]This is my [b]first ever Stardew Valley mod[/b], so thank you for checking it out![/font] ❤️

[size=2][i]This mod was made with the help of AI. I personally wrote the dialogue, but AI walked me through how to code.[/i][/size]

[b][color=#e06666][size=5][i]Installation instructions:[/i][/size][/color][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/b].[/*]
[*]Install [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/b].[/*]
[*]Download [b]Leah Expanded[/b] from Nexus Mods.[/*]
[*]Extract the downloaded
[code].zip[/code]file.[/*]
[*]Place the [b]Leah Expanded[/b] folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]Your Mods folder should look something like:
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/Leah Expanded[/code]That's it! Once installed, the new dialogue will appear naturally as you play and talk to Leah.
Main features
[list]
[*][b]190+ new dialogue lines[/b] for Leah.[/*]
[*]New conversations throughout the year.[/*]
[*]Additional dialogue for different stages of your relationship with Leah.[/*]
[*]New lines that explore Leah's personality, interests, creativity, and life in Pelican Town.[/*]
[*][b]Facial expressions and emotes[/b] added to selected dialogue to give Leah's conversations a little more personality.[/*]
[*]Designed to blend naturally with Stardew Valley's existing dialogue.[/*]
[*]Works alongside the game's normal dialogue rather than replacing Leah entirely.[/*]
[/list]More dialogue may be added in future updates!
Requirements
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley[/b][/*]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b][/*]
[*][b]Content Patcher[/b][/*]
[/list]Please make sure SMAPI and Content Patcher are installed and up to date.
This mod does not require you to start a new save. It can be added to an existing playthrough.

[b]Compatibility:[/b] Leah Expanded is designed to work alongside other mods, but mods that significantly alter or replace Leah's dialogue may affect which lines appear in-game.


[size=5][color=#f1c232]If any of my artistically inclined friends would like to make a custom photo for this mod, I would be forever in your debt![/color] [/size]
